title: Dispatch: olc5.12 item-granted creatures via summoning effects + grant-ended cooldown anchor (attempt 1)
description:
Implements capability eshyra-olc5.12 (read it, parent eshyra-olc5 capability contract, bd recall magic-item-faithful-or-absent, and eshyra-olc5.12 notes incl. the olc5.8 handoff). Branch eshyra-olc5.12.1 cut from eshyra-olc5.12 (= origin/main after the olc5.11 PR merges; cut SHA recorded at dispatch). olc5.11 adds start_effect binding for source.kind 'magic-item' + item effect ref; BUILD ON IT.

CURRENT STATE (verified by captain): mechanics.entityGrant.grants[] {id, kind ('creature'|'illusion'|'object'), creatureRefs (creature:* or table:*), count (number|null), duration ({amount,unit}|null), revertOn (string[]|null), cooldownEconomy?}. 29 grants in 16 blocks (Bag of Tricks, the four elemental vessels, Deck of Illusions, Efreeti Bottle x3, Elemental Gem, Feather Token bird/whip, Figurine of Wondrous Power x10, Horn of Valhalla, Iron Flask, Manual of Golems, Pipes of the Sewers, Ring of Djinni Summoning, Staff of the Python). Runtime: no item grant lifecycle. Existing summon machinery: start_effect semantic family 'summoning' may own linked actors (toolStartEffect.ts, activeEffects.ts), bonded summons (toolRecastBondedSummon.ts, toolTransitionBondedSummon.ts), combatants (encounterCombatants.ts). olc5.8 (PR #660) built applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent(db, ..., {event:'grant-ended', grantId}) in packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts and left F5 'grant-anchored cooldown reset' UNLANDED pending this bead (Ring of Djinni Summoning cooldown, Efreeti Bottle stopper).

CAPTAIN DESIGN (follow; if any part is wrong or the pack is insufficient, STOP and report in notes rather than improvising):
1. Binding: start_effect with family 'summoning', source {kind:'magic-item', ref:<item packRef>, plus the item instance id and a grant id (add inputs following the olc5.11 effect-ref pattern)} validates against the typed grant: every linked actor's creature is in creatureRefs (a table:* ref means the creature must be a row result of that pack table - validate against the table's rows; do not invent), linked-actor count equals the typed count when count is typed (null -> DM-adjudicated), effect duration equals the typed duration when typed (null -> DM-adjudicated). Mismatch / unknown grant / non-creature kind used as creature -> refused. kind 'illusion'/'object' grants: bind only what is typed; do not fabricate combatants for them unless the existing machinery already models that kind.
2. Ending: revertOn values the engine already models end the grant automatically through existing lifecycle (reduced-to-0-hit-points -> the linked combatant's 0 HP path; duration/one-hour-ended/five-rounds-ended -> effect expiry; concentration-ended -> concentration loss). Every other printed revertOn value (owner commands, card moved, third wish granted, next dawn, flight distance, etc.) is DM-triggered via end_effect; tool text says so. Map each revertOn string explicitly in code; an unmapped string fails closed at binding time with a clear error (so a future pack value can't silently bind).
3. Whenever an item-granted summoning effect ends by ANY path, in the same transaction call applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent for that item instance with {event:'grant-ended', grantId} (no-op unless an economy anchors to that grant). Then land F5 'grant-anchored cooldown reset' in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS (remove the olc5.8 staged comment) only if the runtime now fully owns it for both carriers (Ring of Djinni Summoning, Efreeti Bottle stopper).
4. Exclusions (DM-adjudicated, stated in tool text): control/obedience/hostility policy, Iron Flask capture, Manual of Golems crafting time/cost, illusion behaviour.
5. Readiness: land other grant hooks (e.g. F3 owned-entity lifecycle) only if fully owned for every carrier; report the exact ready-operation delta (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady before/after) with a faithfulness note per newly-ready op.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (pack records): Ring of Djinni Summoning grant bound (djinni, count 1, 1 hour) -> djinni reduced to 0 HP ends grant -> cooldown scheduled 24h from that moment; Efreeti Bottle serving-efreeti 1-hour expiry schedules the stopper wait; Figurine (e.g. onyx-dog mastiff 6 hours) bound; wrong creature / wrong count / wrong duration refused; table-ref grant (Bag of Tricks) accepts a table row creature and refuses a non-row; DM end_effect on an owner-command revert ends the grant; unmapped revertOn fails closed.

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: binding design, revertOn mapping table, hooks landed or not with reasons, exact ready delta.
notes:
Dispatched 2026-10-15 as Claude Haiku 5.5 Agent subagent (user: Haiku preferred implementer, Sol final review). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.12.1 on branch eshyra-olc5.12.1, cut from eshyra-olc5.12 = origin/main 339487f1 (olc5.11 merged as #663). Hook registry: LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemCompiler.ts; grant-anchored staging in magicItemTriage.ts ~L1527/L1602.
COMPLETION REPORT (olc5.12.1, Haiku 5.5 dispatch). Commit 9c0ed7b6 on eshyra-olc5.12.1. Not pushed; no PR.

BINDING DESIGN (implemented in core, not in the pack):
- start_effect takes source.grantRef (the printed entityGrant id) plus source.itemInstanceId, with kind "summoning". The engine validates it in createActiveEffect (activeEffects.ts validateItemGrantBinding). The tool only selects the typed duration.
- Grants resolve through the instance variant (effectiveMagicItemMechanics), because the figurines require a variant.
- Refused: unknown grant, non-creature kind (illusion/object are DM-adjudicated), kind other than summoning, no linked actors, count mismatch (when count is typed), linked creature not admitted by the grant. Admission is creatureRefs, statBlockRef by ref or printed name, or a row result of a tableRef matched by printed name. Refused also: a missing or foreign itemInstanceId, a missing concentrationOwner when revertOn has concentration-ended, a duration mismatch without durationOverride, and any atZeroHitPoints the grant does not print. A magic-item summoning without grantRef is refused (use source kind ruling).
- Typed duration: omitted means the typed fixed duration is filled in, mismatch is refused, and override follows the olc5.11 path. Null duration means the DM supplies it.
- Schema: migration 0047 adds active_effect.item_grant_json; snapshot updated; migration pins in migrationLegacyAdoption/persistence tests extended to 47.

REVERTON MAPPING (ITEM_GRANT_REVERT_DISPOSITIONS in activeEffects.ts; unmapped values fail closed at binding time):
- duration-ended: automatic timer (typed duration required)
- one-hour-ended: automatic timer, must equal typed 1 hour
- five-rounds-ended: automatic timer, must equal typed 5 round
- reduced-to-0-hit-points: automatic, linked actors get atZeroHitPoints vanish (vanish-bonded refused)
- concentration-ended: automatic concentration break; concentrationOwner required
- DM-ended via end_effect (reason ruled, note): card-moved, dispelled, maximum-daily-flight-distance-reached, next-dawn, obeyed-owner-command-while-touching, owner-bonus-action-command, owner-command-while-touching, owner-dies, owner-dismisses-as-action, owner-incapacitated, third-wish-granted
- Every revertOn string in the bundled pack is mapped (conformance test enforces this).

GRANT-ENDED ANCHOR: finalizeEnd (the single terminal transition) calls applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent {event:'grant-ended'} in the same transaction, only when the item's effective mechanics anchor an economy to that grant, so unanchored grants stay no-ops. Verified for expiry, 0 HP, and DM end.

HOOKS: NONE LANDED. LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS unchanged, and no importer or pack change, so no regeneration was needed.
- F5 grant-anchored cooldown reset NOT landed. The wait is scheduled only if the grant is bound through start_effect. A narrated, unbound summon leaves the Ring depleted forever (filed eshyra-k3nv). The Efreeti stopper cannot fire at all: it has no depleting operation, and the anchor only schedules depleted economies (filed eshyra-qzc6).
- F3 owned-entity lifecycle, F2 controlled-entity command budget, F5 owned-entity identity link NOT landed. Control is DM-adjudicated, and persistent-actor binding lacks a durable actor requirement (filed eshyra-c58j).

READY-OPERATION DELTA: none (zero). Readiness is computed at emit from the landed-hook registry and the pack, and both are unchanged. Faithfulness note: no op became ready, so none is newly ready.

CONFORMANCE (packages/core/test/itemGrantSummons.test.ts, 7 tests, real pack records):
- Ring of Djinni: use_item spends the summon, then the bound djinni's 0 HP ends the grant and schedules the 24h wait (readiness waived in-test as in olc5.8).
- Onyx Dog figurine: typed 6 hour applied; wrong creature, wrong count, and wrong duration refused; owner-command end via end_effect works.
- Bag of Tricks: weasel (table row) accepted, djinni refused; 0 HP ends the grant.
- Efreeti serving grant: 1 hour expiry ends it through expireElapsedWorldEffects.
- Deck of Illusions, missing concentration owner, missing item instance: refused.
- Mutated pack with unknown revertOn: fails closed.
- Every bundled-pack revertOn maps.

VERIFY: npm run verify:worktree exit 0 (364 files passed, 2 skipped; 6803 tests passed, 3 skipped). Fixes to pre-existing lint: creatureAttackGrammar.test.ts String.raw (noUselessStringRaw), and biome.json schema-vs-CLI version mismatch remains (filed eshyra-ox3d).

FOLLOW-UPS: eshyra-k3nv (P1), eshyra-qzc6 (P1), eshyra-c58j (P2), eshyra-zyvb (P3, illusion/object grants), eshyra-ox3d (P3, biome).
